{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spectrum at the End of the Galaxy''' was a mystical location that some [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] thought they would reach after [[Death/Legends|death]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] treated the Spectrum as a mere superstition, along with other afterlife theories.
